verdict.rationale: Xero ships some built-in autonomous background automation (JAX auto-categorizing/matching bank transactions, auto-extracting bill data from uploads/emails) and offers an official MCP server plus AI Toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain) for building agent-driven workflows against its API. However there's no evidence of a scheduling/trigger/webhook system letting an AI-native user configure a persistent, self-running automation beyond these fixed built-in features. Missing for 10: documented webhook/trigger or scheduler support for custom autonomous agent workflows, independent confirmation that MCP-based automations can run unattended in production.
